rules.description: Detects transactions whose amount significantly exceeds the customer's established baseline median and upper percentile range.
rules.investigator_action: Verify payee relationship, check transfer channel authorization, confirm customer intent.

rules.description: Detects multiple rapid transactions to a newly observed payee within a short timeframe.
rules.investigator_action: Inspect payee creation timestamp, verify if account was newly added, check cumulative payout amount.

rules.description: Detects high-value or unusual transactions conducted outside the customer's typical operating hours range.
rules.investigator_action: Check login IP/device location, assess if transaction coincides with authorized automated schedules or user travel.

rules.description: Detects transactions that simultaneously break multiple customer historical patterns (e.g. channel switch, amount spike, and timing anomaly).
rules.investigator_action: Review multi-factor profile shift, check for potential credential theft or SIM swap signals.
